newsitem.title: MEXICO: IMSA sets 122 mln peso dividend payment.
newsitem.headline: IMSA sets 122 mln peso dividend payment.

text.p: Mexico's IMSA said on Thursday that its board of directors would propose a dividend payment of 122.25 million pesos at the next ordinary general shareholders' meeting.
The steelmaker will also propose the creation of a reserve charged against 1996 earnings to buy back shares.

The agenda for the April 15 assembly, published in daily newspapers, said the company would divide the total dividend payment evenly among 2,771,250,000 shares consituting its shareholding equity, or 0.0441065 pesos per share.
Dividend payments would be made in a lump sum on April 29.
